elements.description: Coordinates in text, checked and marked: hover, focus or right-click one for the place, both notations, mapping links and a map.

properties.name: text
properties.description: The text to find coordinates in: plain text, shown as written (line breaks kept)

properties.name: resolve
properties.description: Supplies a place for a position – a place, null for none, or a promise; used when no tc-coordinate-lookup listener responds

properties.name: trigger
properties.description: What opens a card: "both" (hover, focus and right-click), "hover" (hover and focus) or "contextmenu" (right-click, Menu key, Enter)

properties.name: hoverDelay
properties.description: How long the pointer rests on a mark before its card opens, ms

properties.name: precision
properties.description: Decimal places shown in decimal notation

properties.name: zoom
properties.description: The zoom for mapping links and the map, 1–19

properties.name: providers
properties.description: Mapping tools for "Open in": URL templates with {lat} {lng} {zoom} {label}; empty hides the links

properties.name: embed
properties.description: The map: "click" waits behind Show map; "off" shows none

properties.name: embedSrc
properties.description: The map's address template – {lat} {lng} {zoom} {bbox} – OpenStreetMap's embed by default

properties.name: notFoundText
properties.description: What the card says when there are no details for a place

properties.name: errorText
properties.description: What the card says when the lookup failed

properties.name: coordinates
properties.description: The coordinates found in `text`, in order

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-coordinate-lookup
events.description: A card needs a place's details ({ latitude, longitude, signal, respondWith }: CoordinateLookupDetail); cancelable – call respondWith() with the place (or a promise), or prevent it without responding for "no details"

events.name: tc-copy
events.description: Copy was pressed ({ text, notation }: CoordinateCopyDetail); cancelable – prevent it to copy your own way

events.name: tc-open
events.description: A mapping link is about to open ({ provider, url, latitude, longitude }: CoordinateOpenDetail); cancelable – prevented, the link doesn't open

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: A card opened or closed ({ latitude, longitude }: CoordinateOpenChange; nulls when closed)

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Forgets cached places – one position's, or all of them – so the next card asks again

methods.name: openCard
methods.description: Opens the card for the coordinates at `index` in `coordinates`, pinned open; focus stays where it is

methods.name: closeCard
methods.description: Closes the open card, if any

functions.name: parseCoordinate
functions.description:
Reads one pair of coordinates written as decimal degrees ("38.8977, -77.0365"), decimals with hemispheres
("38.8977° N, 77.0365° W", "N 38.8977 W 77.0365") or degrees, minutes and seconds ("38°53′51.6″N 77°02′11.6″W").
Hemisphere letters say which number is the latitude; without them the latitude comes first. Gives null for anything
else, and for positions out of range. A plain decimal pair needs a comma between its halves and three decimal places
on each, so prices, scores and version numbers aren't read as places.

functions.name: findCoordinates
functions.description:
Every pair of coordinates in `text` that parseCoordinate() reads, in order. Pairs inside words or longer numbers,
out of range, or too vague to be a place (see parseCoordinate) aren't returned.

props.name: onLookup
props.description: Called when a card needs a place's details; call `detail.respondWith(place | promise)` to answer, or use `resolve` instead

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called when Copy is pressed; return false to stop the component writing to the clipboard itself

props.name: onOpenMap
props.description: Called before a mapping link opens; return false to open your own map instead

props.name: onOpenChange
props.type: (position: { latitude: number; longitude: number } | null) => void
props.description: Called with the position whose card opened, or null when it closed

changelog: **Coordinate Details** (`tc-coordinate-details`) – the geospatial partner to ISBN Details. Coordinates in a passage (decimal, hemisphere-lettered or DMS) are found, range-checked and marked; hovering, focusing or right-clicking one opens a card with the place (from your `resolve` or a `tc-coordinate-lookup` listener), decimal and DMS with Copy, "Open in" mapping links and a map that loads only when asked. `trigger` picks hover, right-click or both.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :has()
features.why: Layout and state that depend on what's inside a part (an icon present, a focused field).

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: Popover API
features.without: Lists open fixed to the window instead of in the top layer, so a clipping ancestor or a modal can cover them.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
